notes.title: Final demo release
notes.notes:
✨ We’re excited to bring you the final version of the Echoes in the Storm demo! ✨

Over the past month, players have shared valuable feedback — from suggestions to critiques — and we’ve worked hard to make sure the experience feels better than ever:

🚗 The driving sequence has been streamlined for smoother gameplay.

🕒 Subtitles now last longer, giving you more time to read every message.

🎙️ Improved audio and a polished radio conversation.

🛠️ Object detectors fixed for easier interaction.

🔑 And yes… the sheriff’s drawer is finally accessible!

Curious to know what’s been hiding in there? Jump back into Echoes in the Storm and uncover the sheriff’s secret yourself.

But that’s not all — we’ve also added a special teaser from Chapter 3: step into the chilling morgue of the Polar Scientific Station… if you dare. 🕯️❄️

notes.title: Demo release!
notes.notes:
The demo for Echoes in the Storm is now available! Play through two full levels that introduce the story and core mechanics of the game.

Investigate the gruesome crimes that have just shaken this remote town, now buried under a relentless snowstorm.  



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3880200/Echoes_in_the_Storm_Demo/"][/dynamiclink]

Explore eerie environments and uncover scattered documents to piece together the truth behind these tragic events... Though sometimes, it's better not to know the truth.
